actualCoverage.readMethod: Read every sourceText and Japanese text block in full, plus chapter title and all six notes. Truncated output was supplemented by separately displaying blocks 9-28. Hashes record provenance only, not literary review.

changes.before: 食ももたれるし、夜の眠りも逃してしまう
changes.after: 食がもたれたり、夜に眠れなくなったりする
changes.reason: Preserve alternative possible effects, rather than making both inevitable.

changes.before: 下男の一人にくれてやる
changes.after: 下男の一人に嫁にやる
changes.reason: Restore forced marriage to a male servant, not simply transfer of service.
Keep the same marriage threat explicit in the repeated quotation.

checkedAndRetained: Nurse Li insults, Xiren illness and grievance, Fengjie intervention, age and servant-master voices.
Sheyue staying behind, combing, Qingwen wedding wordplay and mirror exchange without explicit elaboration.
Game stakes of ten cash, one or two hundred cash, one string, and all dice numbers; Baochai mediation and Jia Huan allegations remain distinguished.
Legitimate versus concubine-born status; Zhao Yiniang hierarchy; Fengjie threats involving school and elder brother.
Yuanchun and Tanchun as paternal sisters, Yingchun and Xichun as paternal kin, without falsely asserting shared mothers.
Daiyu and Baoyu quarrel, reconciliation and kinship as his own claim; fur cloak and illness-related diet.
Xiangyun pronunciation wordplay in three places and storyteller closing.

unresolvedSourceQuestions.issue: Dice five plus one versus claimed six is ambiguous.
unresolvedSourceQuestions.decision: Retain numbers and existing note; do not force a total versus single-die interpretation.

unresolvedSourceQuestions.issue: Kinship and precedence maxim has a literal order problem.
unresolvedSourceQuestions.decision: Retain source and note; translation follows the immediately subsequent explanation by Baoyu.

unresolvedSourceQuestions.issue: Awkward source wording in Xiren complaint; translator reports a differing Guiyou reading.
unresolvedSourceQuestions.decision: Retain annotated provisional translation; do not adopt the variant into Chinese.

limitations: Did not independently recollate local Guiyou manuscript. Its citations remain translator-provided evidence.
